summary.text: Dan Sayre is a Democratic state representative from Maine House District 135 who is running for Maine State Senate District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is not seeking re-election to the House.
A business executive who lives in Kennebunk, he assumed office in the House on December 6, 2022.

paragraphs.text: Dan Sayre, listed by Ballotpedia as Daniel Sayre, lives in Kennebunk, Maine, and earned a B.A. in history from Yale University in 1985.

His career experience includes working as president of New World Associates, LLC, executive editor of engineering and geosciences at Oxford University Press, an executive marketing manager at John Wiley & Sons, Inc., and vice president and publisher of Island Press, as well as working as a consultant.
Sayre has been affiliated with the Rotary Club, the Chamber of Commerce, the Brick Store Museum, the American Society for Engineering Education and the Town of Kennebunk Budget Board.
